title: Fix Loop Mode Line Flashing
description: When playing in loop mode, there's a visual bug where the line selection flashes incorrectly: When loop ends: next line briefly flashes as selected before current line restarts. When loop starts: previous line briefly flashes before current line is selected. This creates a jarring, unprofessional UX.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Identify the source of the flash (likely in time update handler or seek logic)
Fix loop restart to not trigger line change events
Current line stays visually selected during entire loop cycle
No visual flicker or flash when loop restarts
Loop mode feels smooth and polished
Verify in browser: enable loop, watch 3+ loops, no flashing (MUST take screenshot)
